question: Should OpenClaw adopt Microsoft Teams multi-bot accounts as a supported bundled-channel contract now?
rationale: The code review can judge correctness, but only maintainers can accept the permanent configuration, upgrade, authentication, state-isolation, and support obligations introduced by this feature.

options.title: Close pending sponsorship
options.body: Close this PR while keeping the canonical issue open, and invite a sponsored reopen when a maintainer accepts the product contract.

options.title: Sponsor the full feature
options.body: Accept the configuration and isolation contract, refresh against current main, and complete exceptional owner review of the full branch.

options.title: Sponsor staged landing
options.body: Require a coordinated series covering schema and compatibility, runtime and state isolation, then setup and documentation while preserving end-to-end proof.

recommendation.title: Close pending sponsorship
recommendation.body: Close this PR while keeping the canonical issue open, and invite a sponsored reopen when a maintainer accepts the product contract.

likelyOwner.reason: This person has the strongest recent ownership signal across the Teams channel, plugin boundaries, and configuration surfaces and was already requested for review.
